**Coaching note:**
Your king was in check on move 15, forcing you to move. Black's rook on c8 just moved there, and now it's undefended. White's knight can reach c7 with check, forking king and rook—a classic knight fork pattern. After your king moves, White captures the rook, winning a whole piece. Look for undefended pieces when you're under attack; often a check that also attacks another piece wins material by force.
